spans.s:
अतन, अस्, m. a passer on; (अम्), n. act of
passing on.
—अतन-वत्, आन्, m. one who wanders.
आ-तन, अम्, n. spreading, expanding; sight, view.
आ-तान, अस्, m., Ved. an extended cord, string, &c.
आतान आ-तान. See under आ-तन्.
अतसि, अत्क, see s. v.

अतसि अतसि, इस्, m. (fr. rt. अत्), Ved. a
wandering mendicant.

अतसी, f. common flax, Linum Usitatissimum; Śaṇa,
Bengal sun used as hemp, Crotolaria Juncea.

अतज्ज्ञ अ-तज्-ज्ञ (for अ-तद्-ज्ञ), अस्, आ, अम्,
ignorant of (तत्) that, i. e. Brahma and the soul's
identity with it.

अतट अ-तट, अस्, आ, अम्, having no beach
or shore, precipitous^1; (अस्), m. a precipice; the
third hell.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210422. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/60.

अतत्त्वविद् अ-तत्त्व-विद्, त्, त्, त्, ignorant of
(तत्त्व) the soul's identity with Brahma.

अ-तत्त्वार्थ-वत् (˚त्व-अर्˚), आन्, अती, अत्, not con-
formable with the nature of truth.

अतथा अ-तथा, आस्, m., Ved. not such,
different; saying अ-तथा, ‘not so,’ ‘no,’ refusing;
careless.
—अ-तथोचित (˚था-उच्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, not
deserving of such (a fate), not thus deserving, not
used to this (with gen.).
अ-तथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, untrue, unreal, not really so.

अतदर्ह अ-तद्-अर्ह, अस्, आ, अम्, not deserv-
ing that; (अम्), ind. undeservedly, unjustly.

अ-तद्-गुण, अस्, m. (in rhetoric) the use of pre-
dicates not descriptive of the essential nature of the
object.

अतन्त्र अ-तन्त्र, अस्, ई, अम्, having no ropes
or no (musical) strings; unrestrained; (अम्), n. not
the object of a rule or of the rule under consideration.

अतन्द्र अ-तन्द्र, अस्, आ, अम्, or अ-तन्द्रित,
अस्, आ, अम्, or अ-तन्द्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, free from lassi-
tude, alert, unwearied.

अतप अ-तप, अस्, आ, अम्, (rt. तप्), not hot, not
excited, not eager; cool; impassible, unostentatious;
unemployed; (आस्), m. pl. a class of deities among
the Buddhists.

आ-तप, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. causing pain or affliction;
(अस्), m. heat of the sun, sunshine.
—आतप-त्र, अम्,
n. a large umbrella of silk or leaves used in the East
as a parasol.
—आतपत्रक, अम्, n. a small um-
brella, a mat or basket carried on the head as one.
—आतप-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, irradiated by the sun.
—आतप-वर्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (water &c.)
produced by rain during sunshine.
—आतप-वारण,
अम्, n. a parasol.
—आतप-शुष्क, अस्, आ, अम्, dried in
[]
the sun, evaporated by the solar heat.
—आतपाभाव
(˚प-अभ्˚), अस्, m. non-existence of sunshine, shadow.

अ-तपस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or अ-तपस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, or
अ-तपस्य, अस्, m. one who neglects तपस् or the prac-
tice of ascetic austerities; an irreligious character.

अ-तप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, not heated, cool.
—अतप्त-
तनू, ऊस्, m., Ved. whose body or mass is cool.
—अतप्त-तपस्, आस्, m. whose ascetic austerity has
not been (fully or properly) endured.
अ-तप्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, not suffering.

अतमिस्र अ-तमिस्र, अस्, आ, अम्, not dark,
not benighted.
अतमेरु अ-तमेरु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. not languid.

अतर्क अ-तर्क, अस्, m. an illogical reasoner;
bad logic.

अ-तर्कित, अस्, आ, अम्, unconsidered, unthought of;
unexpected; (अम्), ind. unexpectedly.

अ-तर्क्य, अस्, आ, अम्, baffling or surpassing thought
or reasoning.
—अतर्क्य-सहस्र-शक्ति, इस्, m. in-
comprehensibly endowed with a thousand powers.

अतल अ-तल, अम्, n. bottomless; N. of
a hell beneath the earth; (अस्), m. Śiva.
—अतल-
स्पर्श, अस्, आ, अम्, or अतल-स्पृश्, क्, क्, क्, touching
the अतल; bottomless; (or it may be अ-तल-स्पर्श,
whose bottom cannot be touched or reached.)

अतव्यस् अ-तव्यस्, आन्, असी, अस्, Ved. not
stronger, not very strong.

अतस् अतस्, ind. (ablative of the pronom.
base अ, synonymous with अस्मात्), from this, than this;
hence; henceforth, from that time; from this (or
from that) cause or reason.
—अत-ऊर्ध्वम्, ind.
henceforth, afterwards.
—अत-एव, ind. for this very
reason; therefore.
—अतः-परम्, ind. henceforth, fur-
ther on.
—अतो-निमित्तम्, ind. on this ground, for this
reason.
—अतो-न्य (तस्-अन्), अस्, आ, अत्, differing from
this.
—अतो-र्हम् (˚तस्-अर्˚), ind. for this object.
अतसाय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be got by begging.
अत्तलि अत्तलि, इस्, m., N. of a man.

आताली आताली, an indeclinable word com-
pounded with अस्, भू, and कृ (see Pāṇini

अत्तव्य अत्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. अद्), fit or
proper to be eaten.

अत्तव्य, अत्ति, अत्त्रि, अद्मन्, अद्य, अद्वन्, &c.,
see s. v.

अत्ता अत्ता, f. (etym. uncertain, probably
a word borrowed from the Deccan, occurring chiefly
in dramas); a mother; mother's sister; elder sister;
(in Prākṛt) a mother-in-law. See अक्का.

आत आत, अस्, आ, m. f. (fr. आ-तन् below ?),
Ved. a scaffold; the frame of a door; (Sāy.) a quarter
of the sky.

आत्त आ-त्त, अस्, आ, अम् (contracted fr. आ-दत्त,
part. pass. of आ-दा, q. v.), taken, accepted; assumed;
attracted.
—आत्त-गन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose
smell is taken away, one who is throttled; hence one
whose pride is humbled, insulted.
—आत्त-गर्व, अस्,
आ, अम्, whose pride has been taken down, humiliated,
degraded.
—आत्त-मनस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, whose mind
is transported or carried away (with joy).
—आत्त-
लक्ष्मी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, stripped of wealth.
—आत्त-वचस्,
आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. destitute of speech.

आतंस् आ-तंस्, Caus. A., Ved. -तंसयते,
-यितुम्, to shake out; (Sāy) to decorate from all
sides.
आतक आतक, अस्, m., N. of a Nāga.

आतक्ष् आ-तक्ष्, cl. 1. P. A., Ved. -तक्षति,
-ते, -क्षितुम्, -तष्टुम्, to bring from all sides, to
procure.

आतञ्च् आ-तञ्च्, cl. 7. P. -तनक्ति, -तङ्क्तुम्
or -तञ्चितुम्, to cause to shrink or contract, to
coagulate.

आ-तङ्क, अस्, m. (this word may also be connected
with rt. तङ्क्, q. v.), disease or sickness of the body;
pain or affliction of mind, disquietude, apprehension,
fear; fever; the sound of a drum or tabor.

आ-तञ्चन, अम्, n. casting one thing into another
to effect some change, as butter-milk into fresh milk
to turn it; the act of causing to contract; that which
causes coagulation; runnet; curdled milk; a sort of
whey; calcining, adding a powder or flux to metals
in fusion; the flux so used; casting away, destroying;
danger, calamity (as a pestilence or epidemic); speed,
velocity; gratifying, satisfying; making fat.

आतड् आ-तड्, cl. 10. P. -ताडयति, -यितुम्,
to thump, strike.

आतन् आ-तन्, cl. 8. P. -तनोति, -नितुम्, to
extend over, stretch over, penetrate, to spread, over-
spread; to illuminate; to take hold of, seek to attain,
assume a (hostile) attitude; to stretch (as a bow for
shooting); to diffuse; to bring to pass, effect: Caus.
-तानयति, -यितुम्, to stretch (a bow); [cf. rt. ताय्,
with which some of the following forms are connected.]

आ-तत, अस्, आ, अम्, spread, extended, stretched (as
2 bow), &c.

आततायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one whose bow is stretched to
take another's life; endeavouring to kill some one;
2 felon, a thief, a murderer, incendiary, ravisher.
—आततायि-ता, f. or आततायि-त्व, अम्, n. persecuting,
murdering, destroying, stealing.

आतता-विन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. one whose bow is
stretched. See आततायिन्.
आ-तनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. spreading, penetrating.
आ-तायिन्, ई, m. a falcon, a kite. See आतापिन्.

आतप् 1. आ-तप्, cl. 1. P. -तपति, -तप्तुम्,
to radiate heat; to blaze, to heat; to cause to glow:
Pass. -तप्यते, to suffer pain, be afflicted; to inflict
(austerities) upon one's self.
2. आ-तप्, प्, f., Ved. heat.

आ-तपन, अस्, m. causing heat, an epithet of
Śiva.
आतपीय, अस्, आ, अम् (adj. fr. आ-तप), sunshiny (?).
आतप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being in the sunshine.

आतम् आ-तम्, cl. 4. P. -ताम्यति, -तमितुम्,
to faint, to swoon, to become senseless; to despond,
to languish, fade away.

आतमाम् आ-तमाम् ? (a superlative form fr.
3. आ ?).
आतर आ-तर. See under आ-तॄ.

आ-तर, अस्, m. fare for being ferried over a river,
passage money, freight.
आतार आ-तार, आ-तार्य. See under आ-तॄ.

आ-तार, अस्, m. landing, coming to shore, fare,
freight.

आतर्ज् आ-तर्ज्, cl. 10. P. -तर्जयति, -यितुम्,
to scold, abuse.
आतर्दन आ-तर्दन. See under आ-तृद्.
आ-तर्दन, अम्, n. pushing open, opening.
आतर्पण आ-तर्पण. See under आ-तृप्.

आ-तर्पण, अम्, n. satisfying, gratification, satis-
faction; whitening the wall, floor or seat on festive
occasions; the pigment used for that purpose.

आतव आतव, a proper N. (whence the
patron. आतवायन Pāṇini
. Gaṇa.)

आतापिन् आतापिन् or आतायिन्, ई, m., N. of the
bird Falco Cheela. See under आ-तन्.

आ-तार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be crossed; (Ved.) land-
ing, coming to shore, relating to landing.
